title: PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Megalotto 6/45 winner gets P15M in November 2 draw
summary: A Megalotto 6/45 bettor is P15 million richer after the November 2 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday evening.

blocks.text: A Megalotto 6/45 bettor is P15 million richer after the November 2 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday evening.
The winning Megalotto numbers of 11-02-26-07-44-05 unlocked a jackpot prize totaling P15,000,000.
PCSO said the lucky bettor purchased the winning ticket from an outlet in Pasay City.
The previous Megalotto winner bagged over P115 million on October 16.
Meanwhile, there was no winner for Grand Lotto 6/55 and its P326,053,355.61 prize. The correct combination was 45-43-07-53-25-48.
